units.source_text: 就这样，发长彦和上回相同，抱着两只狗，带上大公主，

en.t: In this way, Kaminagahiko, just as before, held the two dogs and took the elder princess with him,

units.source_text: 一起骑坐在黑狗背上，命令道：“阿飞，阿飞，

en.t: and together they rode on the black dog's back, and he commanded, "Afei, Afei,

units.source_text: 快点飞去那个笠置山的山洞吧。”

en.t: hurry and fly to that cave on Mount Kasagi."
